summary.zh: 每一位数字是一卷 0-9，各自滚到目标值，从左到右错峰停下。上下边缘做了渐隐，像机械计数器。
summary.en: Each digit is its own 0–9 reel that rolls to the target, settling left to right with a stagger. Top/bottom edges fade like a mechanical counter.

technique.zh: 每列放两遍 0-9，transform: translateY(-(n+10)em) 保证一定往上滚；transition-delay = 列序号 × stagger；mask-image 做边缘渐隐。
technique.en: Each column holds 0–9 twice; translateY(-(n+10)em) guarantees an upward roll; transition-delay = index × stagger; mask-image fades the edges.

adapt.zh: 调用 set(数字) 即可；位数变了先 build(位数)。
adapt.en: Call set(value); call build(len) first if the digit count changes.
